Comment: Stock Data Pipeline: API Fetch → SQLite → RDS PostgreSQL

FetchAPIData.Comment: Phase 1: Fetch data from Yahoo Finance and FMP APIs to SQLite

Retry.Comment: Retry up to 2 times with exponential backoff

CheckFetchStatus.Comment: Check if API fetch succeeded or partially succeeded

Choices.Comment: Full success - proceed to RDS ingestion
Partial success (some scripts failed) - still proceed to RDS if we have stocks and prices

CheckMinimumData.Comment: Check if we have minimum required data (stocks and prices)

Choices.Comment: We have stocks and prices - safe to proceed to RDS

IngestToRDS.Comment: Phase 2: Ingest SQLite data to AWS RDS PostgreSQL

Parameters.Subject: ✅ Stock Data Pipeline - SUCCESS

NotifyPartialFailure.Comment: Notify about partial failure (some API scripts failed but not enough data to proceed)

Parameters.Subject: ⚠️ Stock Data Pipeline - PARTIAL FAILURE

NotifyRDSFailure.Comment: Notify about RDS ingestion failure (API fetch succeeded but RDS failed)

Parameters.Subject: ❌ Stock Data Pipeline - RDS INGESTION FAILED
